svg.title: 退款超时与幂等重试：假想示意

cc:Work.dc:title: 退款超时与幂等重试：假想示意
cc:Work.dc:description: Hypothetical illustration, not a real incident. A refund service durably stores and enforces idempotency for business key R42. A completed 100-yuan refund is not repeated after a lost response and a retry with the same key. Repeating a client string alone does not provide idempotency.
